name: Rising Dragon (Combat, Technique)
body:
With a hit to the center of a foe’s mass, you take them for a ride.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Aerial Ambusher, base attack bonus +4

Benefit(s): When you strike an airborne target, you may forcibly move it 5 feet higher into the air. This feat only works against creatures up to two size categories larger than you. If you deliver a successful attack with a bludgeoning weapon against a creature on the ground, that creature is treated as being 5 feet above your current position until the end of your turn.
